name_zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因/现代化独裁：资源民族主义强人治理与生存博弈
name_en: Saddam Hussein/Modernizing Dictator: Resource Nationalist Strongman Governance & Survival Games
description_zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因 (1937-2006) 1979-2003 统治伊拉克，以石油民族主义为核心合法性：1972 年伊拉克石油公司国有化、1970s-80s 石油收益支撑免费医疗/教育/妇女权利/工业化，同时发动两河战争 (1980-88)、入侵科威特 (1990)、遭受海湾战争 (1991)/制裁/2003 年美军入侵被推翻。核心生存逻辑：资源垄断→再分配合法性→军队/安全部队(特别共和卫队/费达因)绑定→外部冒险转移内部矛盾→情报渗透社会( mukhabarat)。体现 M171 资源民族主义强人治理——资源国有化+收益再分配+反帝叙事+安全部队绑定的闭环生存模式。
description_en: Saddam Hussein (1937-2006) ruled Iraq 1979-2003, core legitimacy via oil nationalism: 1972 IPC nationalization, 1970s-80s oil revenue funded free healthcare/education/women rights/industrialization, while launching Iran-Iraq War (1980-88), invading Kuwait (1990), suffering Gulf War (1991)/sanctions/2003 US invasion toppled. Core survival logic: resource monopoly -> redistribution legitimacy -> military/security binding (Special Republican Guard/Fedayeen) -> external adventurism diverting internal contradictions -> intel penetration (mukhabarat). Exemplifies M171 Resource Nationalist Strongman Governance—closed loop of resource nationalization + revenue redistribution + anti-imperial narrative + security binding.
reason_zh: 萨达姆模式是"资源民族主义+强人统治+外部冒险"三位一体：石油财富买社会契约，战争转移阶级矛盾，安全部队保政权安全。M171 区隔于 M168(缓解)、M170(稳定)，核心在于"对抗性资源夺取+再分配合法性+安全部队绑定"的极限生存博弈。
reason_en: Saddam model is trinity of 'resource nationalism + strongman rule + external adventurism': oil wealth buys social contract, wars divert class contradictions, security apparatus guards regime. M171 distinct from M168 (mitigation) and M170 (stability), core: 'confrontational resource seizure + redistribution legitimacy + security binding' extreme survival game.
steps_zh: 石油国有化夺权：1972 年伊拉克石油公司国有化，打破西方垄断，资源主权成核心叙事
收益再分配契约：免费医疗/教育/妇女权利/住房/工业化，石油换社会契约
安全部队绑定政权：特别共和卫队/费达因/穆哈巴拉特三重保护，忠诚置换专业
外部冒险转移矛盾：两河战争消耗什叶激进/科威特战争争阿拉伯领袖/制裁期走私生存
最终崩塌与遗产：2003 美军入侵/萨达姆绞刑/巴士党解体/去巴士党化/教派内战/ISIS 崛起/重建艰难
steps_en: Oil nationalization power grab: 1972 IPC nationalization, breaks Western monopoly, resource sovereignty as core narrative
Revenue redistribution contract: free healthcare/education/women rights/housing/industrialization, oil for social contract
Security apparatus binding regime: Special Republican Guard/Fedayeen/Mukhabarat triple protection, loyalty replaces competence
External adventurism diverting contradictions: Iran-Iraq War consumes Shia radicals/Kuwait War claims Arab leadership/sanctions-era smuggling survival
Final collapse & legacy: 2003 US invasion/Saddam executed/Ba'ath dissolved/de-Ba'athification/sectarian civil war/ISIS rise/rebuilding struggles
expected_zh: 资源民族主义强人模式在单一资源依赖+外部压力+内部教派裂痕三重夹击下崩塌，留下"资源诅咒+强人陷阱+外部干预"三重警示。
expected_en: Resource nationalist strongman model collapses under triple squeeze of single-resource dependency + external pressure + internal sectarian fissures, leaving triple warning of 'resource curse + strongman trap + external intervention'.
case_zh: 1972 国有化→1980-88 两河战争百万伤亡→1990 入侵科威特→1991 海湾战争/制裁 13 年→2003 伊拉克战争/萨达姆绞刑→教派内战/ISIS/重建至今，石油财富未转化为持久发展。
case_en: 1972 nationalization -> 1980-88 Iran-Iraq War 1M casualties -> 1990 Kuwait invasion -> 1991 Gulf War/sanctions 13 years -> 2003 Iraq War/Saddam executed -> sectarian war/ISIS/rebuilding ongoing, oil wealth never converted to lasting development.
cross_cultural_impact: Strongman survival playbook; resource curse case study; de-Ba'athification lessons; WMD intelligence failure
resource_curse_mitigation: Failed: oil revenue funded wars not development; post-2003 oil law stalled; corruption endemic
